note: Route files loaded through a #[path] declared in another file (a route folder's own sibling file, or a directory file such as routes/admin.rs) are now named and gated by the module declaration that really loads them, so the generated call path resolves and its cfg reaches the route. A test-only cfg no longer hides a route file that an ungated inline module twin loads. A raw identifier module name is reported without its r# prefix in the inline-module error.
